title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Diplomat's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the mutual passage covenant; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
